messages:
Jun - Eng Lead: Hey @people-ops, quick scenario: an IC (Sara) finished a cross-team project and wants comp recognition mid-cycle. She transferred teams two weeks ago. We have quantitative impact but not sure whether to submit as a promotion, off-cycle increase, or spot bonus. Thoughts?
Ava - People Ops: Hi Jun 00: several paths. If role/level changed materially, start a promotion packet. If same level but exceptional contribution, consider a spot bonus or off-cycle merit. We triage on impact, scope, and whether long-term expectations change.
Renee - Compensation: To add: for leveling we need calibrated evidence + band mapping. For spot bonuses we need manager rationale, payout amount, and budget code. Spot bonuses do NOT change base salary. Off-cycle increases do and require comp approval + headcount confirmation.
Jun - Eng Lead: The IC role maps to the same band in the new org, so probably no band change. Manager recommends a one-time payout equivalent to 6% salary. What docs do we need for spot?
Omar - Payroll: For spot payouts: manager approval, people-ops sign-off, comp approval (if >5%), and payroll-form entry by payroll deadline. Deadlines: comp sign-off by 2026-04-10 23:59 UTC, payroll submission by 2026-04-13 18:00 PT. If you miss payroll submission we can run a retro next cycle.
Ava - People Ops: Checklist for you: 
- manager rationale (1 paragraph)
- impact metrics (before/after, links to dashboards)
- peer/lead endorsements (one-line each)
- suggested amount and budget code
- confirmation the action doesn't change base banding (if it does, route to leveling)
Paste that into the HR form: https://intranet.redwood/hr/spot-bonus
Jun - Eng Lead: Can spot bonuses be used to "bridge" until next promo cycle if calibration denies promotion?
Renee - Compensation: Yes, they can be a bridge but we prefer documented expectations. If the calibration committee denies level change but acknowledges strong contribution, comp + people-ops will often recommend a spot or off-cycle increase depending on budget.
Hiring Ops Bot: Reminder: International hires may need local tax gross-up. Flag country in the form or CC employment-ops@redwood.com.
Jun - Eng Lead: Sara is EU-based (Germany). Any special steps?
Ava - People Ops: Germany rules: payroll taxes apply; gross-up rarely approved. Employment Ops needs to confirm whether bonus is taxable at source or needs additional forms. Start the paperwork early.
Omar - Payroll: Also note approvals after payroll submission window will be processed as a retro with breakdown. We include pay-date, gross, tax, and net retro in the notification. Expect one pay period delay.
Jun - Eng Lead: If we decide to do an off-cycle base increase instead of a spot, what's the approval flow?
Renee - Compensation: Off-cycle increase flow: manager proposal -> people-ops pre-check -> comp review (band fit + budget) -> CFO approval if above threshold -> payroll update. Include a proposed effective date. Base increases require HO headcount confirmation.
Ava - People Ops: Template for manager rationale (pasteable):
```
- Employee: Sara M.
- Current band: IC3
- Requested action: 6% spot bonus OR 5% off-cycle base increase
- Core rationale: led cross-team KV cache migration; reduced p99 by 18%; decommissioned 2 legacy services; customer-facing incidents reduced by 40% in rollout window.
- Evidence: PRs: github.com/rw/kv/123, dashboards: /metrics/kv/p99, peer notes: slack.com/archives/C1234/p4567
- Budget owner: Infra Opex 2026-Q2
- Manager: Jun (sign-off)
```
Jun - Eng Lead: Great. Who signs the final email to the IC? We try to be transparent about timing.
Ava - People Ops: People-ops issues the approval letter for promotions/off-cycle increases; manager sends a contextual note. For spot bonuses payroll issues payment and a short notification. People-ops will draft the communication and loop you for review.
Omar - Payroll: One more operational note: include the employee unique ID (EID) in the form to avoid manual lookups.
Jun - Eng Lead: Thanks. I'll assemble docs and submit the spot-bonus form now, CC employment-ops for Germany.
Renee - Compensation: If anyone thinks this should have been a promotion, mark the packet "promo-eval" so comp chairs can re-consider during calibration.
Ava - People Ops: Closing note: if you anticipate equity rebanding, start comp + legal early; equity paperwork lags cash actions by one grant cycle.
Hiring Ops Bot: Action logged: spot-bonus-form-submitted? false. Calibration chairs meeting Wed 2pm PT. Submit items 48h prior. :clock3:
